description: For one commit, show every target's memory change against its base build: per region, the largest section and source-file changes, budget alerts, and, for targets with benchmark metrics, each metric's change. For a pull request, pass the PR's head commit SHA: its base is the tip of the PR's base branch, so the result is the whole PR's change. Use it to review a pull request or check whether a commit grew memory or moved a benchmark.

limit.description: Section, file and metric changes per target (default 10, max 200).

project.description: The project: a public project's GitHub 'owner/repo' (no API key needed), or, with an API key, a project id or name from list_projects.

ref.description: The commit: a full commit SHA, a SHA prefix (7+ characters), or a branch or tag name. Default: the head of the default branch. For a pull request, its head commit SHA.

name: get_commit_summary
title: Commit memory summary
